articleTitle: Microchip Technology Announces Dividend and Buyback
articleBody: Microchip Technology (MCHP) announced today a $1 billion share repurchase program and an increase in its quarterly dividend. The company cited strong cash flow generation and confidence in its long-term strategy.

articleTitle: Micron beats estimates, guides higher on AI memory demand
articleBody: Micron reported Q3 revenue of $6.8B, beating analyst estimates of $6.6B. The company raised its Q4 guidance, citing unprecedented demand for High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) used in AI data centers.

thesis: Unchallenged monopoly in datacenter AI GPUs.
articleTitle: SK Hynix to invest $15B in advanced packaging for AI chips
articleBody: South Korea's SK Hynix announced a massive $15 billion investment in advanced packaging facilities in the US, primarily to support the production of High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) chips that are crucial for Nvidia's AI processors.

thesis: Unchallenged monopoly in datacenter AI GPUs.
articleTitle: AMD launches MI300X, claims to beat Nvidia H100 in inference
articleBody: AMD officially unveiled its MI300X AI accelerator, providing benchmarks that suggest it outperforms Nvidia's flagship H100 GPU by up to 20% in certain large language model inference workloads. Several major cloud providers announced plans to adopt the chip.

articleTitle: NHTSA opens new probe into Tesla Autopilot crashes
articleBody: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) has launched a new investigation into 2.4 million Tesla vehicles after receiving reports of crashes involving the company's Full Self-Driving (FSD) software in low-visibility conditions.

articleTitle: Tesla releases new software update with minor UI tweaks
articleBody: Tesla has started rolling out software update 2024.14.3 to its fleet. The update includes minor improvements to the media player interface and undocumented bug fixes.

thesis: Services revenue growth offsets slowing hardware upgrade cycles.
articleTitle: EU regulators fine Apple €1.8 billion over App Store rules
articleBody: The European Commission has fined Apple €1.8 billion for abusing its dominant position in the market for the distribution of music streaming apps. Apple must also change its App Store rules to allow developers to inform users of cheaper subscription options outside the app.

articleTitle: Apple introduces new color options for iPhone cases
articleBody: Apple quietly updated its online store today, adding several new spring color options for its silicone iPhone cases and Apple Watch bands.
